# GIS Development Skills — Z EARTH local adapter

This directory includes a pinned, reviewed copy of the general [GIS Development Skills](https://github.com/ahmadibrahim4geo/GIS-Development-Skills) documentation. **The authoritative instructions for this desktop project are in the [Z EARTH root AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)**. Project-specific WPF/Cesium contracts take precedence over generic source-repository website/release instructions.

For multifaceted requests use [repository-wide-skill-orchestration.md](references/repository-wide-skill-orchestration.md) and `skills/prompt-intent-orchestrator/SKILL.md`, then the generic `skills/gis-development/SKILL.md` router. Always retain the project-specific `skills/zearth-*` and `skills/cesiumjs-*` specialists. Apply `skills/gis-security-guardian/SKILL.md` (security), `skills/completion-evidence/SKILL.md` (DoneProof verification), and `skills/agent-development-journal/SKILL.md` (honest handoff records) as needed.

The developer [snapshot manifest](../docs/GIS_SKILLS_SNAPSHOT.json) documents exact upstream file hashes. Mark native Windows/WebView2/Globe acceptance NOT RUN unless it was actually observed. No Markdown file grants device permissions, authorizes execution, or installs a WPF/JS runtime capability.
